$comment: Written by .github/workflows/refresh-odds.yml. Never edit by hand - your change will be overwritten on the next run. Line keys are "<week>|<team>", so a market line is found for any team, not just the two the plan names. Same keys in `results`, which is W/L and is what the board marks a locked pick from, and in `scores`, which is the signed margin and is what the rating fit in form.json learns from.
